title: ADR-0105 D10: layered master data (group template + org override) — awaiting its follow-up ADR
body:
Split out of #3541 at close-out (2026-07-30): Phase 0 / Phase 1 / Phase 2 D8+D9 shipped and verified; **D10 is the one remaining framework-side item of Phase 2**, and it is a design item, not a code item.

## What ADR-0105 D10 reserves

A spec-level pattern for the SAP material-master / 用友-金蝶 distribution shape: an object may declare layered governance — group-level **template rows** (platform-global or group-org-owned, read-shared) plus per-org **override rows** linked to the template, with a resolution rule (org override wins).

The ADR deliberately reserves the concept only. The mechanics are explicitly deferred to a follow-up ADR:

- linkage field between override and template rows;
- resolution in the read path vs a view layer;
- distribution policies: 集团统管 / 分级 / 自由;
- how the layered read composes with the D2 union wall and D5 stamping (a template row is readable across the wall *by design* — the first deliberate exception to `organization_id IN accessible_org_ids`, which is exactly why it needs its own decision record).

## Status

**None of ADR-0106…0113 is that ADR** (verified during the 2026-07-30 re-evaluation of #3541). Per ADR-0049 discipline, nothing ships before the decision record exists — the concept is reserved, not licensed.

## Definition of done

The follow-up ADR is proposed (own proposal PR + own tracking issue, per convention — as ADR-0105 itself did via #3499 → #3541). This issue closes when that tracking issue exists and takes over.

Refs: [ADR-0105 §D10](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0105-group-tenancy-posture-and-first-class-org-scope.md), #3541 (close-out), objectstack-ai/cloud#874 (master-data *distribution management* is the commercial face and stays cloud-side per the repo split).
